requisito: Given an email address, a role, and a list of allowed roles, returns the matched role in lowercase if the email domain is exactly azienda.it (ignoring leading/trailing spaces and case) and the role is in the allowed list; otherwise returns "negato".

difetti.indizio: Look at how the email domain is checked.
difetti.spiegazione: The domain comparison uses StringComparison.Ordinal, making it case-sensitive and rejecting valid domains such as "Azienda.it".

difetti.indizio: Look at how each entry is prepared inside the roles loop.
difetti.spiegazione: Calling r!.Trim() without handling a null element in the array throws a NullReferenceException as soon as a null entry is encountered.
